content.short: AdaPunks.net is a Cardano NFT collection of 1,000 algorithmically generated punk collectibles and art.
content.description: AdaPunks.net is a Cardano NFT collection made up of 1,000 algorithmically generated punk collectibles. Each AdaPunk has its own visual traits, and the limited supply is intended to keep the collection focused on distinctive design rather than a large mint count. The project is not affiliated with CryptoPunks, SolPunks, or Larva Labs, but it draws on the broader punk collectible format while giving Cardano collectors a smaller, separate set of character NFTs to trade, hold, compare, and collect today.
